$comment: Core patches to microsoft/vscode, applied in order at build time by build/apply-patches.mjs. Budget: 20 (plan, 'Running the fork' step 3). Each entry needs an owner and a reason. Prefer synapse-core, then the built-in extension, and only then a patch.

patches.reason: Upstream hard-codes 'Microsoft Corporation', a Microsoft copyright and code.visualstudio.com in the Windows/macOS file version info (main executable, bundled native binaries, server) and the Windows installer's publisher fields; build scripts are outside the extension API. The patch reads companyName, copyright and publisherUrl from product.json, falling back to upstream's values.
